newsitem.title: USA: US Mint buys 2,616,000 kg zinc at avg $1.6608/kg.
newsitem.headline: US Mint buys 2,616,000 kg zinc at avg $1.6608/kg.

text.p: The U.S. Mint said Wednesday that it bought 2,616,000 kg of Special High Grade zinc from four firms at an average price of $1.6608 per kg.
It bought 900,000 kg of SHG zinc from Hochschild at $1.6600 per kg and 852,000 kg of zinc from Trademet at $1.6543 per kg.
The Mint purchased 512,000 kg of zinc from Bal Metals at $1.6617 per kg and the final 352,000 kg of zinc from Ore & Chemical Co for $1.6762 per kg.
The total sale price of the zinc was $4,345,246.80, the Mint said.
